description: The name says exactly what the fixture pins: `tell`/`ask`/`each` are reserved WITHOUT the Sprites profile. All three `define`s raise `ol-reserved-word` under `core-language` alone, because `spec/grammar.md:408` makes profile words built-in names unconditionally -- what a profile decides is whether a name WORKS, never whether a program may declare it -- and `spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:154` says the same. Its twin `reserved-procedures-with-sprites` runs this byte-identical source with the profile claimed and expects the same three diagnostics. `"check": true`: it asserts the checker diagnostics, not execution -- the procedures are never called and no events are produced. `message` is absent from the diagnostics below, as it is from its twin: the harness strips it from BOTH sides before comparing (`scripts/harness/index.mjs:977-983` projects every diagnostic to code/span/params/stage/severity), so supplying one here would be an assertion nothing can evaluate. Diagnostic identity is `code` plus `params` and "prose is presentation" (`spec/error-model.md:254-259`); the learner-facing wording is pinned by unit tests instead.
